integrity: A complete finite face construction, integral acyclic-element matching, 210 signed group-orbit sums, and an independent signed fixed-simplex check on the 15-vertex case accompany this result. All methods are reproducible with a standard C++17 compiler and Python 3.
scientific_limitations: Only the five finite parameter pairs (4,15),(5,18),(6,21),(7,24),(8,27) are proved; quotient homology is rational only, and the underlying sphere homotopy type is previously known. No external independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
title: Trivial dihedral orientation in five squared-cycle total-cut seven-spheres
